trello.name: Set up Stripe subscription tiers
trello.desc: Configure Basic ($29/mo), Pro ($49/mo), and Enterprise ($99/mo) tiers in Stripe with their respective features and ensure they are reflected correctly in the app.

trello.name: Build frontend checkout process and update pricing page
trello.desc: Jordan to build the checkout form using Stripe Elements, matching the app's design, handling errors gracefully, including a clear feature comparison, prominent checkout button, and a tooltip explaining plan changes. Also update the pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers.

trello.name: Build user dashboard and integrate frontend with backend API
trello.desc: Jordan to build a dashboard showing current plan details, upgrade/downgrade/cancel options, invoices, payment history, and payment method updates with real-time status. Integrate frontend with backend API to ensure real-time subscription updates, handle integration errors, and provide clear user notifications.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe API and set up webhook handlers
trello.desc: Taylor to integrate Stripe's API for creating subscriptions and processing payments. Set up and test webhook handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed (with email notification), and customer.subscription.deleted. Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests to share with the team.

trello.name: Create user and technical documentation
trello.desc: Team to create user support materials including a help section/FAQ for subscriptions. Taylor to document API endpoints and webhook event handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up meeting
trello.desc: Alex to schedule a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress and address any issues.
